tldr: Midday batch (Sep 2): Alibaba upgraded Qwen3.8-Max to a 0902 snapshot — further post-trained on Coding & Cowork for enterprise-scale and long-horizon agent work, keeping 2.4T params and 1M context at $2/$6 per 1M tokens, still the cheapest frontier-class long-context API. Anthropic extended discounted cache-read pricing to API, SDK and Enterprise, matching what Pro/Max/Teams already had. Rounding out: Australian law firm Gilbert + Tobin shares how it scaled ChatGPT Enterprise and Codex with CEO-led governance; slotstream streams a 104GB Qwen3.8-Flash-Next onto low-memory Macs via expert offloading; and YC-backed Nori Robotics launched a $1,688 bimanual mobile robot for developers.
